themes_detail.label: Asbestos spike in buildings
themes_detail.summary: Asbestos complaints surged to 8 reports THIS WEEK, a 700% spike versus the 1.0 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks (z-score: 5.72), suggesting potential building violations or renovation-related exposure risks affecting Upper West Side residents.
evidence: 8 asbestos complaints THIS WEEK vs. 1.0 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (700% increase, z-score 5.72)
High-severity statistical anomaly indicates concentrated, acute problem rather than baseline condition
Timing aligns with spring renovation season and 1,163 building permits filed in last 90 days (1,083 alterations)
reporting_angles: Which buildings or blocks are generating asbestos complaints? Are contractors following abatement protocols?
Interview residents in affected buildings about exposure fears and remediation timelines; check DOB violation records

themes_detail.label: Curb and street deterioration
themes_detail.summary: Curb condition complaints exploded to 14 reports THIS WEEK, a 367% increase versus the 3.0 weekly average over 8 weeks (z-score: 8.98), signaling accelerating street infrastructure failures across the district.
evidence: 14 curb condition complaints THIS WEEK vs. 3.0 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (367% spike, z-score 8.98)
Complements 975 street condition complaints over 90 days, suggesting broader pavement crisis
Street Light Condition also spiked 167% LAST WEEK (27 complaints vs. 10.1 avg), indicating cascading infrastructure neglect
reporting_angles: Map the 14 curb complaints by block—is this localized to specific avenues (e.g., Broadway, Amsterdam) or district-wide?
Obtain DDOT capital budget allocation for UWS; compare to complaint density in other CD's

themes_detail.label: Dead and dying trees crisis
themes_detail.summary: Dead/Dying Tree complaints jumped to 9 reports THIS WEEK, a 1700% spike versus the 0.5 weekly average over 8 weeks (z-score: 8.5), indicating rapid urban canopy loss or disease outbreak in the district.
evidence: 9 dead/dying tree complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.5 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (1700% increase, z-score 8.5)
Aligns with recurring CB budget request for 'park or amenity upgrades,' suggesting chronic maintenance backlog
Could indicate disease (e.g., Asian longhorned beetle, Dutch elm disease) or winter damage not yet cleared
reporting_angles: Contact Parks Dept: which tree species are affected? Is this a pest outbreak or seasonal die-off?
Survey affected parks/blocks with photos; interview residents about safety concerns (falling limbs near playgrounds, transit stops)

themes_detail.label: Abandoned bikes accumulating
themes_detail.summary: Abandoned Bike complaints hit 5 reports THIS WEEK, a 700% spike versus the 0.6 weekly average over 8 weeks (z-score: 5.11), suggesting growing debris/clutter on streets or bike-share system operational failures.
evidence: 5 abandoned bike complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.6 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (700% spike, z-score 5.11)
May indicate Citi Bike rebalancing issues or surge in personal abandoned bikes post-winter
Contributes to broader street clutter narrative alongside curb and tree deterioration
reporting_angles: Are these Citi Bikes or personal bikes? Cross-check with Citi Bike operational reports from this week
Quick 'before/after' visual feature documenting sidewalk clutter hotspots

themes_detail.label: Street lighting failures spreading
themes_detail.summary: Street Light Condition complaints spiked to 27 reports LAST WEEK, a 167% increase versus the 10.1 weekly average over 8 weeks (z-score: 6.12), creating public safety and visibility hazards across the neighborhood.
evidence: 27 street light complaints LAST WEEK vs. 10.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (167% spike, z-score 6.12)
Occurs alongside curb/street deterioration spike, suggesting systemic sidewalk and pedestrian infrastructure crisis
DOT capital/maintenance budget data needed to assess response capacity
reporting_angles: Map dark blocks and interview residents about safety concerns, especially near transit hubs or parks
Request DOT work orders for street light repairs filed in last 30 days; compare response time to other districts
